text:
Ivy: dropped a prototype for a slightly different take on floors + top-ups — https://figma.link/safety-floor-v1 — calling the floor 'Safety floor' and the ephemeral add-on 'Surge credit'. asking for quick copy + a11y reads. Marcus: love the new names, 'Safety floor' communicates protection. copy alt: 'Baseline reserve' / 'Surge credit (temporary)'. Lina: accessibility first pass: ensure motion reduction preference stops the pulsing cost preview. also keyboard order should be: stepper -> SLO slider -> surge CTA. right now surges are focused before slider. Derek: UX nit: mobile collapsed row hides affordances. propose condensed inline: '2 ⬗ 8' show full labels on focus. also add a tiny chevron to expand details. Ivy: copy options for surge CTA: 'Use surge credit', 'Top up for spikes', 'Apply surge'. short and clear preferred. Marcus: billing clarity: add 'Billed per GPU-minute' under the surge modal and show example: '+1 GPU ≈ $0.58/hr (billed per GPU-minute)'. link to billing doc. Lina: a11y snippet for screen readers: ``` 2 GPUs — Safety floor
Estimated: $1.16 / hr
``` also recommend aria-hidden="true" on decorative icons and descriptive aria-labels on pool badges. Derek: animation: when value changes show a subtle crossfade, but if prefers-reduced-motion then show instant change. QA will test focus retention. Ivy: validation flow: if Safety floor > Max show helper: 'Safety floor cannot exceed Max capacity' with two inline actions: 'Set Max to X' and 'Swap values'. actions must be keyboard-focusable with visible focus styles. Marcus: contrast: surge pill fails 4.5:1 on dark theme. try #004d47 or outline variant + 3px focus ring. Lina: keyboard shortcuts idea: Alt+Up/Alt+Down to jump by +1/-1 on focused stepper. doc the possible conflicts. announce delta in live region: 'Max increased to 6 GPUs (+1)'. Derek: multi-pool edge: some pools disallow surge credit (e.g., preemptible-only). show per-pool state: 'Surge: unavailable' with tooltip 'Surge credit not supported by selected pool'. CTA disabled with link 'Find compatible pool'. QA-Bot: test checklist added: keyboard-only path, reduced-motion path, live-region announcements, contrast checks across themes, mobile condensed labels, validation actions focusable, surge-unavailable state. Ivy: decision items: adopt 'Safety floor' + 'Surge credit' terminology, implement reduced-motion handling, expose billing hint in modal, show condensed numeric on small widths, add 'Swap values' action for invalid floors, debounce live updates 220ms. I'll update figma and post new link by EOD. objections? Marcus: +1 on terminology. Lina: will prototype aria updates and reduced-motion behavior. Derek: will mock condensed mobile row and expand chevron. QA-Bot: i'll add tests and tag PR. DesignBot: checklist appended to thread: reduced-motion support, role=status for cost, aria-hidden for icons, debounce=220ms, contrast >=4.5:1, keyboard shortcuts documented, helper action focusable, tooltip length < 140 chars. Ivy: thanks team 680 44d
